authorization.effect: Design authorization only; not rule acceptance, source discovery, owner adoption, or witness authorization.

scope.use: One synthetic branch for static authored-procedure review, only if GPT accepts and the owner separately adopts the exact reviewed terms.
exclusions: No effect on W1 or its PASS status.
No canon, runtime, actual-campaign, or actual-actor change.

facts.support: Must be actually secured to a real support able to bear load.

limits: No anchor creation/rating, hauling/forced movement, or free slack-drawing lift.
300 lb is static only; no source-defined upward/dynamic conversion.
At 0 HP, spell end, or overload, rope vanishes.

sourceBindings.finding: No bound source defines Reverse Gravity load on secured tether.

sourceBindings.boundary: W1 only; does not supply the W2 tether rule.

proposedTestOnlyRule.type: Branch-local mechanic for one synthetic W2 fixture; not canonical.

definitions.restrainedSystemMassLb: Restrained body + attached/worn gear and cargo + Conjure Rope, each counted once.
definitions.upwardRestraintLoadLb: Equal to restrainedSystemMassLb. This is a new 1:1 test convention in pound-equivalent units, not a source-defined physical-force conversion.
definitions.effectiveCapacityLb: Lower of the source-defined 300-lb Conjure Rope static limit and the named synthetic support TEST_ONLY rating.
definitions.tautBehavior: Inextensible for this test. Slack is consumed geometrically; at first taut contact upward velocity is set to zero before load sampling, so there is no impact or dynamic multiplier.
definitions.threshold: At the taut sample, each component independently fails only if load exceeds its own rating; equality holds. If multiple limits are exceeded, all affected components apply their defined failure result.

sequence: Apply only the supplied upward displacement; do not alter Reverse Gravity source profile.
Consume measured tether slack; no free lifting, hauling, or slack-drawing.
At first taut contact, zero upward velocity and sample the defined TEST_ONLY quasi-static load.
Within both capacities, rope and support hold, block remaining upward displacement for this event, and do not stretch.
If load exceeds the rope limit, apply the existing Conjure Rope overload result: the rope vanishes and restraint ends.

If load exceeds the synthetic support rating, its TEST_ONLY attachment releases without damaging or moving the support. Apply this independently of rope overload; if both limits are exceeded, both failure results occur.
If restraint ends during the scripted event, apply only uncompleted displacement from the current point; do not replay prior movement.
Cargo stays attached to the body unless separately detached; record body, rope, support, cargo, and custody.

caster.qualification: Stipulated qualified/prepared for Conjure Rope solely for this branch; not an actual actor/class claim.

attachmentSetup.operation: TEST_ONLY six-second brief operation secures one rope end to support.
TEST_ONLY six-second brief operation secures other end to consenting target's closed waist harness.

support.kind: Synthetic fixed support assembly anchored to stone

tether.path: Straight vertical unobstructed from support z=-10 ft to harness z=0 ft
tether.slackTakeup: 1 ft upward travel consumes 1 ft slack.

movement.classification: Synthetic TEST_ONLY movement input, not an actual spell cast/campaign event

expectedSettlement.rope: Intact, taut, secured; no stretch or release.
expectedSettlement.fall: None; target remains supported at event end.
expectedSettlement.costs: 2 RP remains paid; no refund or duplicate cast.
expectedSettlement.ropeExpiry: Event ends 24 seconds after cast, before 600-second deadline.

releaseAndFailure.ropeOverloadZeroHpOrExpiry: Rope vanishes under bound source rule; restraint ends; during event only uncompleted displacement then applies.
releaseAndFailure.supportOverrating: Synthetic attachment releases; during event only uncompleted displacement then applies.
releaseAndFailure.voluntaryRelease: TEST_ONLY target-loop release ends restraint; apply only uncompleted displacement and preserve cargo custody.
releaseAndFailure.intactAtEventEnd: Target remains suspended at taut endpoint; no fall.
releaseAndFailure.boundary: No general physical-force model, dynamic-impact rule, actual support rating, or actual-campaign outcome.

directorReviewRequest.decision: PASS, REVISE with exact corrections, or NO on this exact TEST_ONLY W2 rule and fixture.
focus: movement, cargo, custody, support, and fall settlement

List actual spell-source and paid-application evidence that remains separate.
directorReviewRequest.boundary: No witness, seal, blocker closure, identity acceptance/application, canon/runtime mutation, or queue change before Director ruling and separate exact owner adoption.

nonClaims: The 1:1 load convention is new, TEST_ONLY, and absent from bound sources.

revisionNote: The synthetic support rating is 250 lb, below the rope's 300-lb cap, so the support-release branch is reachable while the 210-lb expected case still holds. Each component now independently applies its own over-limit result at the taut load sample.
